School Days

A whole school life at Sunrise Public School, Suryanagar. Wake up at home, ride your cycle or catch the bus, answer in class, eat lunch with friends, collect your marks, and grow up class by class. From Class 12 press J for jobs: exams, interviews and real work.

The school day
7:00Wake up at home. Breakfast, pocket money and tiffin from Maa.
7:30School bus from the Shanti Nagar stop, or your bicycle, or walk: cross at the zebra.
8:00Assembly by the flag. Thought for the day.
8:30, 9:15Two classes. Sit at your desk. Raise your hand to answer: 2 marks each. Subjects rotate each day: Maths, Science, English, EVS.
10:00Lunch on the benches with friends. Canteen sells more.
10:45Third class, then Games on the field with Coach Vikram.
12:15Bus or bicycle home. Homework at your desk, dinner, sleep. A new day.
🚲Your bicycle waits by the garden gate. E to ride, E to get off. It goes anywhere.
FA daysEvery 5th day: a 10 mark test in each subject.
Term examDay 10 and day 20: 20 mark papers, then the report card with grades and class rank.
